articles.title: Deck of Haunts - Official Console Release Date Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Deck of Haunts gets a new trailer and a console release date. Check out the latest Deck of Haunts trailer to see gameplay and more from this sinister deckbuilding roguelike game, where players become a malevolent haunted house. New additions to the console release include new cards and rooms, new starter decks and creative deck building, missions, story, and meta-progression, expanded room-building and human navigation, nightmare mode and the Grim Reaper, new creatures, curated scenarios, and more quality-of-life features and controller improvements.Deck of Haunts will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S on October 8, 2026. It is already available on PC.
